_comment: Indiana 2026-2027 QAP v2, IHCDA. Page numbers are PDF page indices and match the printed 'Page | N'. Section 6 Scoring Criteria, pp.56-93. The summary table on p.56 states section totals of 23 + 52 + 42 + 14 + 30 + 4 and 'Total Number of Points Possible 165'. Every section's items sum exactly to its stated total, and every item was read. BUT 165 IS NOT REACHABLE by any application, for two reasons the document itself states. (1) Explicit exclusions: 6.2(D) Vacant Structure, 6.2(E) Preservation (6 + a 3-point unit bonus) and 6.2(F) Infill each bar the others, so 6.2's 52 includes 12 points no project can combine; and 6.5(E) and 6.5(F) exclude each other by definition, so 6.5's 30 includes 3. (2) Scoring universes: 6.1(A), 6.1(B) and 6.3(B), worth 25, are not scored for 4%/bond applications, and 6.6(A) Bond Experience, worth 4, is scored only for them. Coded as a core track of what every competitive application faces (121) plus a nine_pct add-on (25) and a bond add-on (4), with the exclusions as groups. Hand-summed before loading: core 4 + 40 + 36 + 14 + 27 = 121; 9% ceiling 146; competitive 4% ceiling 125. The loader matched each. The stated 165 is recorded against the core track and reports MISMATCH by design; the track note decomposes the gap (121 + 25 + 4 + 12 + 3 = 165). The document's cross-references among 6.2(D)-(F) and from 6.3(H) are wrong by a letter or a section; they are recorded in the notes. Thresholds are in IN_thresholds.json.

track_totals.note: p.56: 'Total Number of Points Possible 165', the sum of six section totals. MISMATCH BY DESIGN, fully decomposed: the core track holds 121; the 9%-only categories add 25 (nine_pct track) and the 4%-only Bond Experience 4 (bond track); the Vacant/Preservation/Infill exclusion removes 12 and the Institute exclusion 3. 121 + 25 + 4 + 12 + 3 = 165. A 9% application can reach at most 146, and the 9% threshold is 85 (58% of 146). A competitive 4% application can reach 125, and its minimum is set case by case but never below 50.
Add-on for 9% applications: 6.1(A) Rent Restrictions 16, 6.1(B) Income Restrictions 3, 6.3(B) Underserved Areas 6. Each says competitive 4%/bond applications are not scored in it.
Add-on for 4%/bond applications: 6.6(A) Indiana Bond Experience, 4 points.

groups.note: Each of 6.2(D), (E) and (F) bars the other two. The best route is Preservation 6 plus its unit bonus 3 = 9; Vacant and Infill are worth 6 alone. A cap at 9 over all four rows gives that ceiling (the bonus requires 6.2(E), which the cap cannot enforce but the arithmetic respects).
